dashboard.label: SOC Authentication | Bundled Synthetic Demo
dashboard.description: Bundled lookup demonstration. Not indexed event ingestion. All timestamps and identities are fabricated and dated 2026-10-05. Detection results are review hypotheses, not confirmed compromises.

search.query: | inputlookup portfolio_auth_validation.csv | stats count as total_events
| inputlookup portfolio_auth_validation.csv | stats dc(scenario) as scenario_count

panel.title: Login successes and failures over time

search.query: | inputlookup portfolio_auth_validation.csv | eval _time=strptime(replace(timestamp,"Z$","+0000"),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z") | timechart span=10m count by event_type
| inputlookup portfolio_auth_validation.csv | stats count(eval(event_type="login_failure")) as failures count(eval(event_type="login_success")) as successes by source_ip | sort - failures | head 10

panel.title: Candidate successes following five failed attempts (inclusive 600 seconds)

search.query: | inputlookup portfolio_auth_validation.csv | where event_type="login_failure" OR event_type="login_success" | eval _time=strptime(replace(timestamp,"Z$","+0000"),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z") | where isnotnull(_time) AND isnotnull(username) AND isnotnull(source_ip) | sort 0 _time | streamstats current=f count(eval(event_type="login_success")) as prior_successes by username source_ip | fillnull value=0 prior_successes | eval failure_epoch=if(event_type="login_failure",_time,null()) | streamstats current=f list(failure_epoch) as prior_failure_times by username source_ip prior_successes | eval age_seconds=mvmap(prior_failure_times,_time-tonumber(prior_failure_times)) | eval eligible_ages=mvfilter(isnotnull(age_seconds) AND age_seconds>=0 AND age_seconds<=600) | eval failure_count_in_window=coalesce(mvcount(eligible_ages),0) | where event_type="login_success" AND failure_count_in_window>=5 | table timestamp username source_ip host scenario failure_count_in_window
| inputlookup portfolio_auth_validation.csv | table timestamp username source_ip host event_type scenario | sort timestamp
